items.summary: Improper input validation in Citrix NetScaler ADC/Gateway lets an unauthenticated attacker execute arbitrary commands on default deployments. Actively exploited in the wild as a zero-day before patches; Citrix released fixes on Sep 27, 2026 (14.1-73.37, 13.1-64.23).

Memory overflow in Citrix NetScaler ADC/Gateway exploitable when DTLS is enabled (default for VPN virtual servers), enabling remote code execution or denial of service. Actively exploited in the wild; patched Sep 27, 2026 in the same fixed builds.

HTTP request smuggling in Citrix NetScaler ADC/Gateway that can bypass security controls on front-end servers. Disclosed in the same Sep 27, 2026 Citrix bulletin alongside the two exploited zero-days; same fixed builds.

Path traversal in the widely used Node.js `decompress` npm package (before 10.2.2 / 11.1.4): crafted archives could write files outside the target directory, enabling arbitrary file overwrite and RCE.

Out-of-bounds write in Apple CoreGraphics — a maliciously crafted file can lead to arbitrary code execution. Apple says it may have been exploited in an "extremely sophisticated attack" against targeted individuals; fixed in iOS 26.7.1, macOS Tahoe 26.7.1, and macOS Sequoia 15.8.1. Apple publishes no CVSS score for it.
